verdict.rationale: Ollama is designed to run on the user's own machine. Evidence includes a one-line install script, local base URLs for its REST API, an open GitHub repository, and the claim that "nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine." Community users independently confirm running it locally on their own hardware, including AMD GPUs via ROCm containers, and embedding it in products. missing for 10: first-party docs on server/deployment configuration (users complain server settings are hidden and GPU setup can fall back to CPU), and the larger cloud-only models are not self-hostable.
